name: Immunofluorescence Staining of Cultured Cells (2 Days)
description: Indirect immunofluorescence on cells grown on coverslips in a 24-well plate: fixation, permeabilisation, blocking, overnight primary antibody at 4 °C, secondary antibody, DAPI and mounting. Times assume one 24-well plate. Prepare beforehand: 4% PFA in PBS, 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS, blocking buffer (1% BSA + 5% normal goat serum in PBS).

steps.title: Fix & permeabilise cells
steps.notes: Aspirate medium, wash 2x PBS. Fix in 4% PFA 15 min at RT. Wash 3x PBS, 5 min each. Permeabilise in 0.1% Triton X-100 in PBS, 10 min at RT. Work in the fume hood for PFA.

steps.title: Blocking (1% BSA + 5% NGS, RT)
steps.notes: 300 µL blocking buffer per well, 1 h at RT on a gentle rocker.

steps.title: Add primary antibody
steps.notes: Dilute primary antibody in blocking buffer (e.g. 1:200). Invert coverslips onto 50 µL drops on parafilm in a humid chamber.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation (overnight, 4 °C)
steps.notes: Humid chamber at 4 °C, 14-18 h (16 h planned).

steps.title: Washes & secondary antibody setup
steps.notes: Return coverslips to the plate. Wash 3x PBS, 5 min each. Dilute secondary antibody 1:500 in blocking buffer; protect from light from here on.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation (dark, RT)
steps.notes: 1 h at RT in the dark.

steps.title: Washes, DAPI & mounting
steps.notes: Wash 3x PBS, 5 min each. DAPI 1 µg/mL, 5 min. Wash 1x PBS, dip in water. Mount on slides with antifade medium, let cure in the dark before imaging.
